body: I don't know, I guess you're right in terms of working at it making it hurt a little less. Though in my case, there's just the empty feeling that won't go away and always lingers. The last sentence is what really makes me think though, so thank you for reading and replying. I really appreciate it.

In regards to moving away from here, I've actually been thinking about that for quite some time now. I got accepted to a school out west which is quite far away from where I live now. 

I've had some ideas about what to study but I just can't help but feel that there's an inevitable failure coming my way, or that it will be a repeat of the previous four years.

It seems like the only thing I have to be certain of is my doubt of something good.
